messages.subject: Gene annotation
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to overlap my differentially methylated regions with genic features. I am working with soybean genome and annotation file is available in only gff3 format. I used cufflinks and Galaxy software to convert it to BED format. When i run the command, I get an error :

> gene.obj <- readTranscriptFeatures("/Users/aditirambani/desktop/Gmax_275_Wm82.a2.v1_exons.bed.txt")

Error in .Call2("solve_user_SEW0", start, end, width, PACKAGE = "IRanges") : 
  solving row 3: negative widths are not allowed

Please find first 1000 lines of my input BED format file attached with this email. Is the input not in correct format ? Why do I get an error message ?

I will appreciate your help

Thank you

Aditi

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Gene annotation
parts:
there is something wrong with your file that it creates negative width for a genomic feature. It could be a format issue, I'm not sure how good are those gff3 to bed conversion tools

Best,
altuna
